summary.text: One of the twelve suitors from Ithaca itself in Apollodorus' catalogue — a name formed from Dulichium, but listed among the wooers native to Ithaca rather than the island contingent.

story.text: Apollodorus names Dulicheus among the twelve wooers of Penelope who came from Ithaca itself, listed with Antinous, Pronous, Liodes, Eurynomus, Amphimachus, Amphialus, Promachus, Amphimedon, Aristratus, Helenus, and Ctesippus.
